ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.3 Aggressive Lean V1
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: A clean rebuild of RimMT T34-D.2.3 for RimWorld 1.5. Retains the aggressive parallel scanner plus the measured-positive T21/T28/T32, DoBill, T4, Common Sense and text-cache paths. Removes T34-A/B/C, S4/S5.1, T22, T26, Clean Pathfinding experiments and resident attribution probes from the compiled assembly. Scanner types that complete a worker wait above 8 ms still fail open and are quarantined.
